root.name: アルカミ・テクノロジー

relations.text: Q2 Holdingsの年次報告が、アルカミ・テクノロジーを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Alkami Technology as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Q2 Holdings 10-K
source.quote: With respect to our digital banking platform, we have several point solution competitors, including Candescent, Alkami Technology, CSI, Backbase and Lumin Digital in the online, consumer and SMB banking space and Finastra and Bottomline Technologies in the commercial banking space.

companies.name: プロビデント・ファイナンシャル・サービシズ

relations.text: 傘下のProvident Bankが、135店舗網でMANTLの口座開設を稼働させたとAlkamiが発表した
relations.text_en: Alkami announced that Provident Bank is live with MANTL Business Account Opening and Retail Account Opening across its 135-branch network

source.label: Alkami の発表
source.quote: Alkami Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALKT), a digital sales and service platform provider for financial institutions in the U.S., today announced that Provident Bank (Provident) is live with MANTL Business Account Opening and Retail Account Opening across its 135-branch network.
source.note: 傘下のProvident Bankとの関係で、Alkamiの子会社MANTLの製品です。
source.note_en: Relationship is with subsidiary Provident Bank, for a product of Alkami's MANTL unit.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
